summary: This tutorial covers how to customize the JChemPaint software, a chemical structures editor. It starts by opening the JChemPaint window on Ubuntu Linux OS version 12.04 with JChemPaint version 3.31210 and Java version 7. Key steps include changing the panel background color through the Preferences menu, selecting from various color options including HSB, RGB, and others depending on your operating system. The tutorial also explains how to change the user interface language to Spanish or other languages available in the Other Preferences tab. Additionally, it demonstrates adding templates to the software by navigating to the Templates menu or using the side toolbar, and viewing the list of available structure templates in the Structure Templates window.
